ab.seg:
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa rin po che'i snang ba zhes bya ba | 'gro ba'i mgon
po zhang rin po che'i bu chen ¦ bla ma grub thob ti shri ras pa'i dbon po sngags mtshan nyid kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas snyim pa me tog dang bcas nas yang dang yang du gsol
ba btab pa'i ngor | dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir ¦ yongs 'dzin gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dka' 4 'dzin pa la stod pa rgyal ba bzang pos kyang dang dngos cher × byas nas bskul byed dang sdeb sbyor kyi rkyen sbyar te ° bde At the request of the spiritual friend Kun dga' rgyal mtshan, who possesses numerous qualities of mantra and philosophical learning, a nephew of the accomplished master Ti Shri Res pa and a close disciple of the protector of beings Zhang Rin po che, who repeatedly made requests with palms joined together with flowers directly [to me]; for the sake of fulfilling the intentions of the glorious and holy masters; the tutor and spiritual friend praised as an upholder of the four [treatises], called rGyal ba bzang po, encouraged, checked, and provided the [material] conditions for this work...
